statement: Added crates/enforcer-scan/src/outcome.rs (Outcome::Ran{validator_count}|Skipped{reason: SkipReason}, with SkipReason a parse-at-boundary newtype rejecting empty/whitespace strings via TryFrom<String>) and crates/enforcer-scan/src/coverage.rs (Coverage::from_outcomes folds TargetOutcome{file,outcome} into ran_count/skipped_count/skips, and Coverage::require_nonzero_ran() -> Result<(), DecodeError> hard-fails when ran_count==0). Both are new additive modules wired into lib.rs via `pub mod coverage;`/`pub mod outcome;` — engine.rs/modes.rs/router were not touched.
why: Workpack a09 owns exactly these two files: anti-silent-skip accounting so a scan that ran zero checks can never masquerade as a clean pass, plus a typed run outcome distinguishing ran vs skipped-with-reason.
howToApply: a10 (capstone, dogfood wiring) consumes Coverage::require_nonzero_ran() as the hard-fail gate before reporting CI success, and should thread per-file Outcome values from engine.rs's dispatch loop (currently `let Some(source) = source else { continue };` silently drops unreadable files — a10 or a future engine-owning pack should replace that continue with an explicit Outcome::skipped(...) fed into Coverage) — engine.rs itself is out of scope for a09 by workpack boundary, so this wiring is deliberately deferred, not forgotten.

statement: serde's #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", tag = "kind")] on an internally-tagged enum only camelCases the tag value and variant names — it does NOT cascade into struct-variant field names (Outcome::Ran{validator_count} still serialized as "validator_count" under camelCase rename_all). Needed the separate `rename_all_fields = "camelCase"` attribute (serde >=1.0.127) to camelCase the struct-variant's own fields.
why: A wire-form test (outcome_wire_form_is_camel_case_tagged) failed with left:Null right:2 because it asserted wire["validatorCount"] but the actual key was "validator_count" — rename_all alone does not reach into variant payloads for internally/adjacently tagged enums.
howToApply: Any future internally-tagged enum in this workspace requiring camelCase wire form on both the tag and any struct-variant fields must set BOTH `rename_all` and `rename_all_fields` on the enum's serde attribute; a single rename_all is insufficient and will silently under-camelCase without a compile error.

statement: enforcer-scan/Cargo.toml did not previously depend on ts-rs even though enforcer-domain (its dependency) does and re-exports ts_rs::TS-deriving types. Adding new ts_rs::TS-deriving public types (Outcome, SkipReason, Coverage, SkipRecord) required adding `ts-rs = "10"` directly to enforcer-scan's [dependencies] (pinned inline, matching enforcer-domain's pin, since ts-rs is intentionally excluded from [workspace.dependencies] per a01's root-manifest doctrine).
why: cargo build failed with an unresolved `ts_rs` path until the dependency was added; this is a one-time crate-level gap, not a workspace-wide issue.
howToApply: Any crate adding its first ts_rs::TS-deriving type must check whether ts-rs is already in its own Cargo.toml (not just a transitive dependency) before deriving TS — grep sibling crates' Cargo.toml for the exact pin string ("ts-rs = \"10\"") to stay consistent.
